name: Renewal quote preserves prior net (no fresh contributor base)
what_it_tests: A renewal line (QuoteAction.Type='Renew', QuoteTypeText='Renewal') preserves prior NetUnitPrice in the derived formula, is NOT reset to 0, and is excluded from non-renewal/base-stamp/partner-derived branches; renewal maintenance auto-created
proc_mechanism: Derived Pricing Formula (IF QuoteTypeText='Renewal' then NetUnitPrice); NetUnitPrice Value Reset (IF Renewal then NetUnitPrice else 0); Stamp Base Filter & Partner Discount-Derived Maint exclude renewals
expected_behavior: Renewal carries prior net; NetUnitPrice not reset to 0; no fresh contributor base stamping; renewal maint SKU (RC_43000/43120) created
test_setup: QuoteTypeText='Renewal', derived maintenance line, prior NetUnitPrice present

prior_run.actual: After Force-reprice under active V21: FR6D Renew line VM-BSL-RSL-BESECB NetUnitPrice=7110.41 (COLA 7110.41, Pre_COLA 6695.3, 6.2%), Base_Price__c=null, NetTotal/TotalPrice=7110.41. FRPZ Renew line same SKU NetUnitPrice=1453.47 (discounted, distinct from COLA 5830.54) preserved, Base_Price__c=null. Derived maint PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK present on both. None reset to 0.
prior_run.notes: V21 confirmed Active (ExpressionSetDefinitionVersion 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, v21). Renewal branch (Derived Pricing Formula + NetUnitPrice Value Reset, steps 39-40) preserves prior net on QuoteAction.Type=Renew lines; Stamp Base Filter (step 105) correctly excludes them (Base_Price__c null). Defect_provenance SC-3350/SC-3346 concerned the non-derived license/subscription COLA NetUnitPrice seed regression under V16; not reproduced on V21 Renew lines here (net non-zero, preserved across reprice). RC_43000/RC_43120 are external/Workday SKU codes (no Product2 in UAT); the in-org derived maint SKU is PI…
